apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. Rotator cuff tendinopathy with a PT no-overhead-press restriction isn't a preference — I don't override that. "I know my body" doesn't lift it; only the clinician who set it does.

I won't add overhead pressing to Wednesday. Wed Aug 5 stays Upper Body Strength [fix-26] — want me to check what's on it and make sure nothing in there is overhead-loading the shoulder either?
